map.算法：MAP ≈ 舒张压 + (收缩压−舒张压)/3；脉压 = 收缩压−舒张压；: Algorithm: MAP ≈ diastolic + (systolic−diastolic)/3; pulse pressure = systolic−diastolic; grading: MAP≥70 normal, 65-69 borderline, <65 low. Systolic must be ≤300 mmHg and diastolic ≤200 mmHg, and diastolic must not exceed systolic.
map.平均动脉压 MAP（本页代码口径）：MAP = 舒张压+(收缩压−舒张压)÷3（: Mean arterial pressure MAP (as implemented on this page): MAP = diastolic + (systolic − diastolic) ÷ 3 (mmHg, an empirical approximation since diastole takes about 2/3 of the cardiac cycle); related value: pulse pressure = systolic − diastolic (mmHg). Validation: systolic must be >0 and ≤300 mmHg, diastolic >0 and ≤200 mmHg, and diastolic must not exceed systolic; out-of-range input is flagged and the calculation stops (heart rate is displayed only and not used in the calculation). Grading: MAP ≥70 normal, ≥65 borderline, <65 low (risk of inadequate organ perfusion).
